title: DKIM signing failure in NNTP queue silently defers without bound — no dead-letter
description: In NntpQueue drain_once (queue.rs line 228-234), if signer.sign() fails, the article is deferred with 'continue' — it stays in the queue and will be retried on every subsequent drain cycle. There is no dead-letter move, no retry counter, and no max-retry limit. A persistent signing failure (e.g. corrupted key seed, mail_auth internal error) will cause the queue to grow without bound while the drain loop spins. Meanwhile the same article is retried every retry_interval seconds with 0 evidence of the failure beyond warn\! logs. Contrast with relay_queue.rs which correctly moves to dead/ on DKIM failure. Fix: add a retry counter or move to dead/ after N consecutive DKIM signing failures, consistent with relay_queue.rs behavior.
